Restrict open egress rule to tcp/443

Encryption at rest cannot be enabled in place; changing storage_encrypted forces replacement and would destroy data. Snapshot the instance, copy the snapshot with encryption (kms_key_id), restore it as a new aws_db_instance, cut over, then remove the old one.

Encryption cannot be enabled in place; changing encrypted forces replacement and would destroy data. Snapshot the volume, create an encrypted volume from the snapshot, re-attach it, then remove the old volume.

Role can iam:PassRole and create compute (lambda:createfunction). Scope iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs, add an iam:PassedToService condition, and split the creation permission into a separate role. Not auto-fixed: the right scope depends on which role and service need it.
